note: The crime table (PLAN.md W5). A row is a crime id -> heat added, the minimum stars it sets at once, whether a witness is needed, and `lethal`: once a lethal crime is on a player's record, police shoot on sight and no arrest is offered, until the heat is gone or the player is hospitalized. Adding a crime = one row here + one WantedSystem.report(id, ...) call. Stars come from heat by `stars_at` (thresholds for 1..6 stars). `police_weapons` is what responding police carry (the dispatch, PLAN.md W5): heavy weapons once the player is lethal-wanted (user, 2026-10-03).

dispatch.note: The police dispatch (game.EnforcementDispatch, PLAN.md W5). Index = stars (0..6). Officers on foot appear between foot_min and foot_max metres from the wanted player out of view; patrol cars (POC1/MPC1, a crew of car_crew) on a lane between car_min and car_max and drive the road route to the player, the crew bailing out within arrive_dist. From shoot_at stars (1: police HUNT the player down, user 2026-10-07) police are hostile and shoot; there is no arrest by proximity -- a wanted player who goes down is arrested (RecoveryRules). Units are freed out of view past despawn_far, or once the stars are gone. While police can see the player the calm clock does not run (seen_reach).
dispatch.escalation_note: PLAN.md W6 (user 2026-10-06): heavier units as the stars rise. Index = stars (0..6). weapons_by_stars: what a unit carries (the lethal list in police_weapons is added once lethal). vehicles_by_stars: catalog model ids sent (POC1/MPC1 patrol cars, ARV1 armoured riot vehicle, LTK1 wheeled light tank, TNK1 tank). snipers_by_stars: SNR1 units placed 90-160 m out on a clear line. helis_by_stars: police helicopters (HLC1) with a door gunner. ram_at: from this many stars a car on a call drives AT the player instead of stopping to unload. gun: the armour that fires a main gun, and how.

fees.note: What waking up costs (game.RecoveryRules, user 2026-10-06), yen, taken from the player's cash (never below 0). HOSPITALIZED pays `hospital`; ARRESTED -- which a death while police-wanted is too -- pays (hospital + police_per_star) x the stars; an ABDUCTION's ransom is gangs.json `abduction`, the highest.
